Bjp.source:
function Bjp takes unit Cm returns boolean
local player RT=GetOwningPlayer(Cm)
local string TS
local integer Zm
local boolean Zn
set TS=Sv[GetPlayerId(RT)]
if GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$68303438 then
set Zm=SE
elseif GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$68303432 then
set Zm=SL
elseif GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$68303254 then
set Zm=SP
elseif GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$68303535 then
set Zm=SJ
elseif GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$68303543 then
set Zm=SH
elseif GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$68303538 then
set Zm=SK
elseif GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$48303938 then
set Zm=SG
elseif GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$48303856 then
set Zm=SF
elseif GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$4830354E then
set Zm=SI
elseif GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$48303941 then
set Zm=SM
elseif GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$48303936 then
set Zm=SO
elseif GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$48303939 then
set Zm=SS
elseif GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$48304244 then
set Zm=SQ
elseif GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$48303855 then
set Zm=SR
elseif GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$68303441 then
set Zm=SN
else
call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(RT,0,0,5,"|cffff0000[Error]|r 해당 유닛은 스킨이 존재하지 않습니다.")
set RT=null
return false
endif
set Zn=LoadBoolean(SD,StringHash(TS),Zm) or (GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==TT and Bjm(RT))
set RT=null
return Zn
endfunction

CHy.source:
function CHy takes nothing returns nothing
local player iF=Player(Wl)
local integer iH=Wn
local integer iG=Wo
local integer VU=LZ[GetPlayerId(iF)]
local real EN
local real JS
local unit Cm
local integer EK=0
if WV then
set EN=WW
set JS=WX
else
set EN=GetPlayerStartLocationX(iF)
set JS=GetPlayerStartLocationY(iF)
endif
loop
exitwhen EK==iG
set Cm=CreateUnit(iF,iH,EN,JS,bj_UNIT_FACING)
if GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$48303939 or GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$48304232 then
call BH0(VU,Cm,$48303854)
else
call BH1(VU,Cm)
endif
call GroupAddUnit(Q6,Cm)
set EK=EK+1
endloop
set iF=null
set Cm=null
endfunction

Global Q4 counters, navigation effects and quest callbacks are not certified by this callback audit.
Kuma still requires an external settled source story event; no free acquisition is introduced.
